datum_that_decided_the_role: D01;D03;D04 (no site, no maximum, no triheteromer, no measured selectivity) with D02 (the only potency is a patent calcium-flux IC50) and D05-D07 (human exposure only in depression and healthy volunteers)
what_would_change_the_role: A primary source or a new experiment showing (a) ifenprodil-site occupancy by competition or amino-terminal-domain mutation, and (b) maximum inhibition on GluN1/GluN2B against GluN1/GluN2A/GluN2B triheteromers under stated glutamate, glycine, Zn2+ and pH: a site equal to ifenprodil's with a different triheteromer maximum would make it a mechanism comparator; the same ceiling would make it a chemotype control only
novelty_for_LEGEND: Not new as a molecule (present in an earlier QA relations table, a coverage matrix and raw lookups, never discussed as a comparator); new as a comparator for a GluN2B-NAM arm
novelty_new_combination: Yes as a second scaffold sharing the hydroxyaryl-ethanolamine arrangement of ifenprodil-type ligands (INFERENZA from structure, not a site datum), with human exposure. Role unchanged after verification: the corrections (diheteromer maximum not reported; structure resemblance only inferred) leave the site, maximum and triheteromer questions open. Comparison that stays interpretable without its site: whether a different chemotype removes the same measured percent of the isolated NMDAR current as ifenprodil (supports a target-level reading, i.e. not a single-chemotype off-target effect). Not interpretable: any claim of independence from ifenprodil's site, or of a different assembly ceiling, or a link between its human effects and a Wwox-related defect
novelty_verified_in_perimeter: Europe PMC and PubMed strings of 2026-11-10 (onfasprodil, MIJ821 with WWOX, epilepsy, pH/slice terms): zero WWOX hits; 12 epilepsy-string hits were reviews or an unrelated slice paper; ClinicalTrials.gov MIJ821 records all depression or healthy imaging; repository mentions per the IT41 verifier (name grep); no Novartis or Cadent poster or database beyond ChEMBL, GtoPdb and the patent was searched

datum_that_decided_the_role: D08;D09;D10 (potency depends on bath pH by a declared 6-fold and a same-origin 21 versus 130 nM pair, the series maximum moved little, the size is molecule-specific) with D12;D13;D15 (site inferred, triheteromer maximum and native datum absent) and D14 (H1 73 and 40 nM and hERG 620 and 621 nM are same-origin repeats; the 30-fold has an unstated pH); the role does not rest on the absence of a second pH value or on the H1 figure alone
what_would_change_the_role: (a) a measured bath pH of the preparation (and Mg2+) that differs from physiological, which would turn it into a probe of that condition; (b) the maximum effect at each pH with stated conditions, and a triheteromer test, for NP10679 (an IC50 pair already exists at abstract level); (c) a competition or mutagenesis result placing it at the ifenprodil site; a measured pH at the normal level would make the pH dependence irrelevant to the preparation
novelty_for_LEGEND: Not new as a name (one registry row and raw lookups under another spelling); new as a comparator and as a condition-linked probe
novelty_new_combination: Yes: its use is subordinate to a premise, namely that the extracellular pH of the preparation differs from the pH at which a conventional NAM is characterised, which is unmeasured and not assumed. If pH is held and matched it behaves as one more NAM of probable ifenprodil-site action. Without a bath pH measurement its effect cannot be separated from the pH dependence of the compound itself, and the pH dependence does not make the compound favourable Role unchanged after verification: the IC50 pair at two pH values narrows M03 but supplies no maximum, site or native datum.
